prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screens, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for home new screens, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_screen: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Generation Preview Modal: Add a dedicated pet verification screen after photo upload so users can inspect and tweak their pet render before completing adoption. (why: Adoption conversion is 66.2% with a long mean duration of 1017s, and support logs show 3 separate tickets about custom pet renders failing or looking wrong.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Progress Persistence Warning: Display explicit security and data retention hints on the sign-in screen informing users how logging in preserves their adopted pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again under different accounts or credentials.)
2: [home, wait_info] Background Desktop Initialization Status: Enhance the waiting screen with real-time status messages, animated progress indicators, and time estimates while desktop assets load. (why: The waiting step (home target) takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, while support received tickets where pets failed to appear on desktop.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Story Scroll Stage: Transform the path selection screen into a dynamic story-scroll layout showcasing companion archetypes with video clips. (why: Choose path drops to 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating users pause or get distracted without engaging visuals.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Overlay Calibration Screen: Insert a desktop overlay calibration step right before completing onboarding to test graphics rendering and screen position. (why: Support logged 3 issues where pets failed to display on desktop or the desktop window did not launch properly, contributing to finish drop-off.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Comfort Tip Carousel: Add a delayed tip carousel on the path choice screen comforting users that their choice can be changed later. (why: The mean time spent on choose_path is 514s (median 8s), showing extreme outlier delays when users get stuck making a decision.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Account Login Assistance Alert: Add a background notification status banner to sign-in screen to assist users if authentication window stalls. (why: Sign-in screen drops to 72.9% conversion, and 2 support tickets mentioned sign-in screens not appearing or stalling.)
7: [home, new_flow] Desktop Environment Readiness Check Flow: Add a diagnostic check screen during the waiting step that verifies display permissions and background process execution. (why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s, and support receives tickets regarding pets failing to display on desktop after onboarding.)
